$comment: Every gid below was confirmed against real pixel data with `node tools/tile-rgb.cjs 0 197`
(exact RGB histogram + opacity per tile), not by eye.
Rules used to accept a tile:
- ground/terrain tiles must be 100% opaque, otherwise the layer below shows through
- the tile must be dominated by that terrain's signature colour
- tiles are 1-based gids (firstgid = 1), i.e. gid = tile index + 1
There is no road tile in this tileset: the only gold rgb(253,190,83) pixels sit
in gid 3 at 13% coverage (a small decoration on grass), so TerrainType.Road has

grass.note: gid 1 is flat rgb(132,198,105) at 100%; 2 and 3 add texture and a small decoration.

water.note: gid 38 is 93% rgb(117,227,255); 93 and 94 match at 93%.

mountain.note: gid 111 is the densest stone tile: 67% slate + 19% light + 14% mid, fully opaque.

forest.note: gid 28 is 94% opaque with 41% trunk/bark + 43% canopy, so it reads as a full tree.
